# HeatmapChartElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasHeatmapChartElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasHeatmapChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasHeatmapChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasHeatmapChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

**Derived elements:** [`UltraCanvasCalendarHeatmapElement`](UltraCanvasCalendarHeatmapElement.md), [`UltraCanvasContourChartElement`](UltraCanvasContourChartElement.md), [`UltraCanvasHexbinChartElement`](UltraCanvasHexbinChartElement.md), [`UltraCanvasSpectrogramElement`](UltraCanvasSpectrogramElement.md)

## What it is for

A matrix of values as colour: heatmap, hexbin, contribution calendar

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasHeatmapChartElement> CreateHeatmapChartElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasHeatmapChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `HeatmapScale`

HeatmapColormap (the available colour maps) is defined in UltraCanvasColormap.h. How a raw value is mapped onto the normalized [0,1] colour-map position.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Linear` |  |
| `Logarithmic` | useful for magnitudes spanning many orders (e.g. dB-less spectra) |

### enum `HeatmapRowOrder`

Where data row 0 is displayed. TopDown is the natural matrix orientation; BottomUp puts row 0 at the bottom (e.g. lowest frequency at the bottom of a spectrogram).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TopDown` |  |
| `BottomUp` |  |

### enum `HeatmapRenderMode`

Cell rendering strategy. Cells - draw one filled rectangle per cell (supports borders + value text, crisp edges; best for small/medium matrices). Image - rasterize the matrix into a pixmap and blit it scaled (smooth, cheap for very large grids such as spectrograms). Auto - pick Cells for small grids, Image for large ones.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Auto` |  |
| `Cells` |  |
| `Image` |  |

### enum `HeatmapCellShape`

Shape drawn for each cell in Cells render mode.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Rectangle` |  |
| `RoundedRectangle` |  |
| `Circle` | dot heatmap |

### enum `HeatmapTriangularMask`

Show only part of a (square) matrix, e.g. for correlation matrices.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoMask` | show all cells (named to avoid the X11 'None' macro) |
| `Lower` | col &lt;= row |
| `LowerNoDiagonal` | col &lt; row |
| `Upper` | col &gt;= row |
| `UpperNoDiagonal` | col &gt; row |
